title: The Veil of the Weeping Wood Again
author: Cyrus Dunmore
blurb: Sable Sterling, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
